es: Plantear contingencias con Should + sujeto + verbo base, in the event of / in the event that y failing that, y leer un plan de contingencia sencillo.

vocabulary.es: a falta de, si eso falla

teaching.en: Should demand fall, we will use the cash reserve to pay the rent.
teaching.es: Si la demanda bajara, usaremos la reserva de efectivo para pagar el alquiler.
teaching.explanationEs: Should + sujeto + verbo base equivale a if pero es más formal; no lleva -s ni will después del sujeto.
segments: Should demand fall, we will use the
cash reserve to pay the rent.
teaching.audioText: Should demand fall, we will use the cash reserve to pay the rent.

teaching.en: In the event of a supplier delay, we will order from a local shop.
teaching.es: En caso de retraso del proveedor, pediremos a una tienda local.
teaching.explanationEs: In the event of + sustantivo introduce una eventualidad concreta; la consecuencia va con will.
segments: In the event of a supplier delay,
we will order from a local shop.
teaching.audioText: In the event of a supplier delay, we will order from a local shop.

teaching.en: We will ask the supplier for a discount; failing that, we will look for another one.
teaching.es: Pediremos un descuento al proveedor; si eso falla, buscaremos otro.
teaching.explanationEs: Failing that presenta el plan B cuando lo anterior no funciona.
segments: We will ask the supplier for a discount;
failing that, we will look for another one.
teaching.audioText: We will ask the supplier for a discount; failing that, we will look for another one.

teaching.en: We have a contingency plan for every major risk.
teaching.es: Tenemos un plan de contingencia para cada riesgo importante.
teaching.explanationEs: Contingency plan es el documento o la lista de acciones previstas si algo sale mal.
teaching.audioText: We have a contingency plan for every major risk.

teaching.en: A shortfall in sales of two thousand dollars would not close the workshop.
teaching.es: Un déficit de ventas de dos mil dólares no cerraría el taller.
teaching.explanationEs: Shortfall es la diferencia entre lo que se esperaba y lo que se consigue; aquí se usa would para lo hipotético.
segments: A shortfall in sales of two thousand
dollars would not close the workshop.
teaching.audioText: A shortfall in sales of two thousand dollars would not close the workshop.

teaching.en: Should stock run out, we will buy parts from a local shop.
teaching.es: Si se agotaran las existencias, compraremos piezas en una tienda local.
teaching.explanationEs: Stock es el material disponible; run out significa agotarse.
segments: Should stock run out, we will
buy parts from a local shop.
teaching.audioText: Should stock run out, we will buy parts from a local shop.

prompt.es: Escribe cuatro planes de contingencia breves para tu taller de bicicletas.

answer.text: Should demand fall, we will use our cash reserve and reduce our opening hours. In the event of a supplier delay, we will order parts from a local shop. Should stock run out, we will ask customers to wait. Failing that, we will offer them a discount.
accepted: Should demand fall, we will use our cash reserve and reduce our opening hours. In the event of a supplier delay, we will order parts from a local shop. Should stock run out, we will ask customers to wait. Failing that, we will offer them a discount.

Should sales fall, we will reduce our costs and use the reserve. In the event of a late delivery, we will call another supplier. Should the stock run out, we will borrow parts from a friend. Failing that, we will tell customers to come back tomorrow.

feedback.es: Un buen plan combina Should + base, in the event of y failing that con acciones concretas.

origin.text: Tienes un taller de bicicletas. Escribe cuatro planes: si baja la demanda (Should…), si el proveedor se retrasa (In the event of…), si se agota el stock (Should…) y un plan B (Failing that,…).

prompt.es: ¿Qué frase dice lo mismo que «If prices rise, we will look for a new supplier»?
